name: Lorenz convection model
question: Does the Lorenz model of convection forget its initial state at its largest Lyapunov exponent, as the predictability law says?
assumptions: the three-mode truncation of Rayleigh-Benard convection with sigma = 10, r = 28, b = 8/3

provenance.source: E. N. Lorenz, Deterministic nonperiodic flow, J. Atmos. Sci. 20, 130 (1963)

closure: three-mode Galerkin truncation of Rayleigh-Benard convection between free boundaries
observable: the amplitude x of the convection roll
